corrections.text: The article states that 'After the rocket reached orbit, Chandana said, "We have done everything that could be done to test Vikram-1 on the ground," and added, "I think this is a historic moment not just for Skyroot but also for India."' Per SpaceNews, only the second remark was made after reaching orbit. The first quote was made 'in a prelaunch statement,' before liftoff.
